description.value: Sikanni River Ranch is a wilderness guest ranch nestled in the Sikanni River Valley of northern BC, surrounded by the Canadian Rocky Mountains, offering a mix of handcrafted log lodges and backcountry cabins. The ranch caters to adventurous travellers with activities including trail rides, ATV rides, snowmobiling, fishing, non-guided hunting, and hiking. A touring cyclist seeking remote northern BC accommodation would find multiple bookable units, on-site meals, and a sauna after a long day in the saddle.
